data.explanation: This is a bill from your electrician for repair work done in your home. You need to pay the total amount by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. Keep this invoice: labour and travel costs for household craftsman work like this can often be deducted from German income tax (Handwerkerleistungen, §35a EStG), but only if you pay by bank transfer, not cash — a tax advisor can confirm the exact deductible share. If you don't pay in time, the company may send a reminder (Mahnung) and could add late fees.
